question: Which customers placed orders worth more than 300, and what were the order dates?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, o.order_date
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.total > 300;
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name, o.order_date FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.total > 300 ORDER BY o.order_date;

question: Which customers have purchased each product?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.name AS product_name, c.name AS customer_name
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY p.product_id, c.customer_id;
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.name AS product_name, c.name AS customer_name FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY p.name, c.name;

question: Which orders contain at least one Furniture product?
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.category = 'Furniture';
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.order_date FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Furniture' ORDER BY o.order_id;

question: How many different product categories has each customer purchased?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS category_count
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.category) AS category_count FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY category_count DESC;

question: How many units were sold in each product category?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.category;
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold FROM products AS p JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY units_sold DESC;

question: What is the average order amount for each customer who has placed an order?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.name, AVG(o.total) AS avg_order_amount
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name;
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(o.total) AS average_order_amount FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY average_order_amount DESC;

question: How many different products are included in each order?

question: Which customers have spent more than the average order amount across all orders?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING SUM(o.total) > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM orders);
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(o.total) AS total_spent FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name HAVING SUM(o.total) > (SELECT AVG(total) FROM orders) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

question: Which customers have purchased a Laptop?
generated_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM customers AS c
JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Laptop%';
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND p.name = 'Laptop') ORDER BY c.name;

question: What is the total sales revenue for each product, including products that have never been ordered?
generated_sql:
SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * p.price), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM products p
LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, COALESCE(SUM(p.price * oi.quantity), 0) AS total_revenue FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: What is the latest order date for each customer, including customers who have never placed an order?
generated_sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS latest_order_date
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
ORDER BY c.customer_id;
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS latest_order_date FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY c.name;
